name: AVA Rocky Mountains
old_description: Bringing Cutting-Edge Technology Home with User-Friendly Systems.
about:
AVA Rocky Mountains operates from Silverthorne, Colorado, serving the High Rockies region and the broader state. The company was established by a team whose combined experience in audio-visual and automation technology spans more than three decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been published.

The firm designs and installs integrated low-voltage systems for homes and commercial properties. Its service portfolio covers audio and video distribution, home theater and media room construction, LED lighting design, structured networking, telephone systems, entry systems, and whole-home automation. A cloud-based remote monitoring platform — built on ihiji's OVRC gateway — allows the team to watch control processors, touch panels, routers, projectors, and networked displays around the clock, performing remote reboots and diagnostics before an on-site visit is needed.

Customers fall into two main groups: residential owners looking to upgrade their living spaces, and commercial and hospitality clients requiring large-scale AV and control solutions. Projects range from single-room media installations to property-wide automation across the Colorado High Rockies.

The company positions itself on simplicity and speed, promising expedited project delivery and a free in-home consultation to start each engagement. Its differentiator is the proactive monitoring layer, which aims to detect, diagnose, and resolve issues — often without rolling a truck — reducing downtime for end users.
